title: Norwegian-Style Salmon with Salad
description: A simple and flavorful recipe featuring pan-seared salmon, a fresh salad, and crispy biscuits.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Pan-sear the salmon in a hot skillet with 1 tbsp of oil until browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the salmon to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the salad by combining mixed greens, diced red onion, and grated carrots in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together light mayo and umami soy sauce.
Dress the salad with the mayo-soy sauce mixture.
Serve the pan-seared salmon on top of the salad, accompanied by crispy biscuits on the side.
Enjoy your delicious Norwegian-style salmon with salad!
